heading: Our Areas of Practice
intro: Legal support across personal, corporate, property and dispute-related matters.

services.title: Corporate & Regulatory Compliance
services.description: Business and company registration, CAC filings, annual returns, post-incorporation services and regulatory guidance.

services.title: Property & Real Estate Law
services.description: Property due diligence, land transactions, title searches, tenancy matters and agreements.

services.title: Family Law
services.description: Divorce, child custody, child welfare and related family legal matters.

services.title: Litigation & Dispute Resolution
services.description: Legal advice and representation in disputes, negotiation and appropriate resolution procedures.

services.title: Contract Drafting & Review
services.description: Clear contracts, commercial agreements, review and contractual risk advice.

services.title: Maritime & Commercial Law
services.description: Maritime-related legal advice and commercial legal matters.

services.title: Debt Recovery & Recovery of Premises
services.description: Debt recovery, property recovery and related legal matters.

services.title: Criminal Law & Defence
services.description: Legal consultation and representation in criminal matters where professionally appropriate.

note: Regulatory support identified by the firm includes NAFDAC registration, SCUML certification, tax compliance, NSITF and other regulatory certifications, subject to Counsel's confirmation of current processes.
